subject.title: [Feature]: Collapsible messages in Control UI chat

question: Should Control UI add inline collapse for long assistant Markdown, and what threshold, latest-message behavior, and global-control policy should it use?
rationale: Current main already has side-reader, JSON, tool-card, duplicate-message, and activity disclosure patterns, so automation should not choose another default disclosure state without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Bounded Inline Collapse
options.body: Add a first version that collapses older long assistant messages by line or height threshold, keeps the active/latest response expanded, and defers global controls unless maintainers want them now.

options.title: Use Side Reader Only
options.body: Decline inline collapse for now and treat the existing canvas/sidebar reader plus truncated-history fetch as the supported long-message escape hatch.

options.title: Defer For Broader Chat UX
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers design a broader chat readability and accessibility pass across messages, tools, JSON, and sidebars.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Inline Collapse
recommendation.body: Add a first version that collapses older long assistant messages by line or height threshold, keeps the active/latest response expanded, and defers global controls unless maintainers want them now.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent full-message side-reader follow-up commits make steipete the strongest routing candidate for the overlapping Control UI disclosure policy.
